title: Redis Cluster Overview
description: Redis cluster health at a glance: topology, load, memory, keyspace, replication and persistence. Source: Telegraf inputs.redis -> InfluxDB (InfluxQL).

list.name: instance_group
list.label: Instance Group
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM redis_cmdstat WITH KEY = "instance_group"
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM redis_cmdstat WITH KEY = "instance_group"

list.name: instance_name
list.label: Instance Name
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM redis_cmdstat WITH KEY = "instance_name" WHERE "instance_group" = '$instance_group' AND "instance_name" !~ /pomb/
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM redis_cmdstat WITH KEY = "instance_name" WHERE "instance_group" = '$instance_group' AND "instance_name" !~ /pomb/

list.name: instance_node
list.label: Node
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM redis WITH KEY = "instance_node" WHERE "instance_group" = '$instance_group' AND "instance_name" = '$instance_name'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM redis WITH KEY = "instance_node" WHERE "instance_group" = '$instance_group' AND "instance_name" = '$instance_name'

list.name: command
list.label: Command
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM redis_cmdstat WITH KEY = "command" WHERE "instance_group" = '$instance_group' AND "instance_name" = '$instance_name'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM redis_cmdstat WITH KEY = "command" WHERE "instance_group" = '$instance_group' AND "instance_name" = '$instance_name'

panels.title: Nodes Online
panels.description: Son 2 dakikada veri gönderen Redis instance sayısı.

targets.query: SELECT count("v") AS "n" FROM (SELECT last("uptime") AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND time > now() - 2m GROUP BY "instance_node")

panels.title: Masters
panels.description: Master rolündeki instance sayısı (replication_role = master).

targets.query: SELECT count("v") AS "n" FROM (SELECT last("uptime") AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND "replication_role" = 'master' AND time > now() - 2m GROUP BY "instance_node")

panels.title: Replicas
panels.description: Replica rolündeki instance sayısı (replication_role = slave).

targets.query: SELECT count("v") AS "n" FROM (SELECT last("uptime") AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND "replication_role" = 'slave' AND time > now() - 2m GROUP BY "instance_node")

panels.title: Connected Clients
panels.description: Tüm node'lardaki bağlı client toplamı.

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "Clients" FROM (SELECT last("clients") AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(previous)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Ops / sec
panels.description: Cluster genelinde saniyede işlenen komut sayısı (tüm node'ların toplamı).

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "Ops" FROM (SELECT last("instantaneous_ops_per_sec") AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(previous)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Memory Used
panels.description: Tüm node'ların used_memory toplamı.

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "Memory" FROM (SELECT last("used_memory") AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(previous)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Hit Rate
panels.description: Keyspace hit oranı: hits / (hits + misses). %95 üstü iyi, %80 altı kırmızı.

targets.query: SELECT sum("h") / (sum("h") + sum("m")) * 100 AS "Hit Rate" FROM (SELECT non_negative_difference(last("keyspace_hits")) AS "h", non_negative_difference(last("keyspace_misses")) AS "m" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Rejected Connections
panels.description: Seçili zaman aralığında maxclients limiti nedeniyle reddedilen bağlantı sayısı. 0 olmalı.

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "Rejected" FROM (SELECT non_negative_difference(last("rejected_connections")) AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Node Status
panels.description: Her Redis instance'ının anlık durumu (son 2 dk). Role: MASTER / REPLICA. Replicas = master'ın gördüğü bağlı replica sayısı. Fragmentation > 1.5 sarı, > 2 kırmızı. Rejected = maxclients nedeniyle reddedilen toplam bağlantı (0 olmalı).

targets.query: SELECT last("connected_slaves") AS "Replicas", last("clients") AS "Clients", last("blocked_clients") AS "Blocked", last("instantaneous_ops_per_sec") AS "Ops/s", last("used_memory") AS "Memory", last("mem_fragmentation_ratio") AS "Fragmentation", last("rejected_connections") AS "Rejected", last("uptime") AS "Uptime" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND time > now() - 2m GROUP BY "instance_node", "replication_role"

panels.title: Ops/sec per Node (now)
panels.description: Yükün node'lara dağılımı. Bir node diğerlerinden çok yüksekse hot shard vardır.

targets.query: SELECT last("instantaneous_ops_per_sec") FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND time > now() - 2m GROUP BY "instance_node"

panels.title: Ops/sec by Node
panels.description: Node başına saniyedeki komut sayısı (yığılmış: toplam alan = cluster toplamı).

targets.query: SELECT mean("instantaneous_ops_per_sec") FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)

panels.title: Connected Clients by Node
panels.description: Node başına bağlı client sayısı.

targets.query: SELECT last("clients") FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)

panels.title: Network In / Out (cluster)
panels.description: Cluster toplam ağ trafiği. In yukarı, Out aşağı çizilir (aynı eksen).

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "In" FROM (SELECT mean("instantaneous_input_kbps") AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(previous)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

SELECT sum("v") AS "Out" FROM (SELECT mean("instantaneous_output_kbps") AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(previous)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: CPU Usage by Node
panels.description: Redis sürecinin CPU kullanımı (user + sys), tek çekirdeğin yüzdesi. %100 = bir çekirdek dolu.

targets.query: SELECT (non_negative_derivative(last("used_cpu_user"), 1s) + non_negative_derivative(last("used_cpu_sys"), 1s)) * 100 FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)

panels.title: Rejected Connections / sec
panels.description: maxclients nedeniyle reddedilen bağlantılar (cluster toplamı). Her zaman 0 olmalı.

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "Rejected" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("rejected_connections"), 1s) AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Used Memory by Node
panels.description: Node başına used_memory.

targets.query: SELECT last("used_memory") FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)

panels.title: Memory Fragmentation Ratio
panels.description: used_memory_rss / used_memory. 1.0–1.5 normal, 1.5 üstü sarı, 2 üstü kırmızı (fragmentasyon). 1'in altı swap riski.

targets.query: SELECT last("mem_fragmentation_ratio") FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)

panels.title: Memory per Node (now)
panels.description: Node başına anlık used_memory.

targets.query: SELECT last("used_memory") FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND time > now() - 2m GROUP BY "instance_node"

panels.title: Evicted / Expired Keys per sec
panels.description: Evicted = maxmemory baskısıyla atılan key (0 olmalı). Expired = TTL ile doğal silinen key.

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "Evicted" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("evicted_keys"), 1s) AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

SELECT sum("v") AS "Expired" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("expired_keys"), 1s) AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Memory: Used vs RSS (cluster)
panels.description: Used = Redis'in kullandığı; RSS = OS'un ayırdığı. Aradaki fark fragmentasyon/overhead.

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "Used" FROM (SELECT last("used_memory") AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(previous)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

SELECT sum("v") AS "RSS" FROM (SELECT last("used_memory_rss") AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(previous)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Total Keys (masters)
panels.description: Master node'lardaki toplam key sayısı (replica'lar sayılmaz, çift sayım yok).

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "Keys" FROM (SELECT last("keys") AS "v" FROM "redis_keyspace" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND "replication_role" = 'master' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node", "database" fill(previous)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Keys by Node
panels.description: Node başına key sayısı (tüm database'lerin toplamı).

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") FROM (SELECT last("keys") AS "v" FROM "redis_keyspace" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node", "database" fill(previous)) GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)

panels.title: Hit Rate by Node
panels.description: Node başına keyspace hit oranı (%).

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_difference(last("keyspace_hits")) / (non_negative_difference(last("keyspace_hits")) + non_negative_difference(last("keyspace_misses"))) * 100 FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)

panels.title: Keyspace Hits vs Misses per sec
panels.description: Cluster toplam lookup; miss payı büyüyorsa cache verimi düşüyor.

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "Hits" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("keyspace_hits"), 1s) AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

SELECT sum("v") AS "Misses" FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("keyspace_misses"), 1s) AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Keys vs Keys with TTL (masters)
panels.description: Toplam key ve TTL'si olan key sayısı. Fark = kalıcı key'ler.

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "Keys" FROM (SELECT last("keys") AS "v" FROM "redis_keyspace" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND "replication_role" = 'master' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node", "database" fill(previous)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

SELECT sum("v") AS "With TTL" FROM (SELECT last("expires") AS "v" FROM "redis_keyspace" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND "replication_role" = 'master' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node", "database" fill(previous)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Connected Replicas by Master
panels.description: Her master'ın gördüğü bağlı replica sayısı. Düşüş = replica koptu.

targets.query: SELECT last("connected_slaves") FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND "replication_role" = 'master' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)

panels.title: Replication Sync Events
panels.description: Aralık başına sync sayısı. Full sync (kırmızı) pahalıdır; sık görülüyorsa repl-backlog yetersiz.

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") AS "Full" FROM (SELECT non_negative_difference(last("sync_full")) AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

SELECT sum("v") AS "PartialOK" FROM (SELECT non_negative_difference(last("sync_partial_ok")) AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

SELECT sum("v") AS "PartialErr" FROM (SELECT non_negative_difference(last("sync_partial_err")) AS "v" FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Master Link: Last I/O (replicas)
panels.description: Replica'nın master'dan en son veri aldığı süre (sn). 10 sn üstü sarı, 30 sn üstü kırmızı: replikasyon gecikiyor.

targets.query: SELECT last("master_last_io_seconds_ago") FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND "replication_role" = 'slave' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)

panels.title: Latest Fork Duration (BGSAVE)
panels.description: Son fork() süresi. Büyük dataset'te fork uzun sürer ve o anda Redis bloklanır.

targets.query: SELECT last("latest_fork_usec") FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)

panels.title: RDB Changes Since Last Save
panels.description: Son RDB snapshot'tan beri yazılan değişiklik sayısı (kaybedilebilecek yazma miktarı).

targets.query: SELECT last("rdb_changes_since_last_save") FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)

panels.title: Time Since Last RDB Save
panels.description: Son başarılı RDB kaydından bu yana geçen süre.

targets.query: SELECT last("rdb_last_save_time_elapsed") FROM "redis" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node" fill(none)

panels.title: Calls/sec by Command
panels.description: Seçili komutların saniyedeki çağrı sayısı (cluster toplamı). Komutlar üstteki Command değişkeninden seçilir.

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("calls"), 1s) AS "v" FROM "redis_cmdstat" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND "command" =~ /^$command$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "instance_node", "command" fill(none)) GROUP BY time($__interval), "command" fill(none)

panels.title: Avg Latency by Command
panels.description: Komut başına ortalama süre (µs/call, tüm node'ların ortalaması).

targets.query: SELECT mean("usec_per_call") FROM "redis_cmdstat" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND "command" =~ /^$command$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "command" fill(none)

panels.title: Top 10 Commands (calls/sec, now)
panels.description: Şu an en çok çağrılan 10 komut (Command değişkeninden bağımsız).

targets.query: SELECT sum("v") FROM (SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("calls"), 1s) AS "v" FROM "redis_cmdstat" WHERE "instance_group" =~ /^$instance_group$/ AND "instance_name" =~ /^$instance_name$/ AND "instance_node" =~ /^$instance_node$/ AND time > now() - 5m GROUP BY time(1m), "instance_node", "command" fill(none)) GROUP BY time(1m), "command" fill(none)
